svg.title: Minor third (m3): information sheet, phone layout
svg.desc: Minor third, m3: C4 to E♭4, 3 semitones. A keyboard from C4 to C5 with both keys highlighted in this interval's identity colour and 3 numbered semitone hops. Two time strips show the notes one after another and together. Plogger [3] lens: Modal family (rounded), ← Fundamental, Non-harmonic (Plogger), dense/dark.

g.text: 3 letter names counted inclusively (C to E)
HOW TO READ THE THREE PLOGGER MARKS
perfect-group family. A family label, not a
The identity colour is a separate, artistic
Root C4 stays; upper note E♭4→D4, one key
apart. Plogger: A changes, B same, C changes.
Root C4 stays; upper note E♭4→E4, one key
apart. Plogger: A same, B same, C changes.
How to read: find C4 on your keyboard, then
count 3 keys up, white and black, to E♭4.
The numbered arcs are those hops. Top left
shows the two notes one after another, top
right the same two notes together.
